1	export type Cell = [x: number, y: number];
2	
3	const isSameCell = ([x, y]: Cell, [otherX, otherY]: Cell): boolean =>
4	  x === otherX && y === otherY;
5	
6	const NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS: Cell[] = [
7	  [-1, -1],
8	  [-1, 0],
9	  [-1, 1],
10	  [0, -1],
11	  [0, 1],
12	  [1, -1],
13	  [1, 0],
14	  [1, 1],
15	];
16	
17	const neighborsOf = ([x, y]: Cell): Cell[] =>
18	  NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS.map(([dx, dy]): Cell => [x + dx, y + dy]);
19	
20	const isLive = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): boolean =>
21	  liveCells.some((liveCell) => isSameCell(cell, liveCell));
22	
23	const countLiveNeighbors = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): number =>
24	  neighborsOf(cell).filter((neighbor) => isLive(neighbor, liveCells)).length;
25	
26	const withoutDuplicates = (cells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
27	  cells.filter(
28	    (cell, index) =>
29	      index === cells.findIndex((other) => isSameCell(cell, other)),
30	  );
31	
32	const isLiveNextGeneration = (cell: Cell, liveCells: Cell[]): boolean => {
33	  const liveNeighbors = countLiveNeighbors(cell, liveCells);
34	  return liveNeighbors === 3 || (liveNeighbors === 2 && isLive(cell, liveCells));
35	};
36	
37	const cellsThatCouldChange = (liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
38	  withoutDuplicates(liveCells.flatMap((cell) => [cell, ...neighborsOf(cell)]));
39	
40	export const nextGeneration = (liveCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
41	  cellsThatCouldChange(liveCells).filter((cell) =>
42	    isLiveNextGeneration(cell, liveCells),
43	  );
